# EconNexus

> Agentic AI tutors, notes, diagrams, and exam intelligence for A-Level and university economics.

EconNexus deploys 11 specialist AI personas across Economics, Business, Sciences, and Law. Content is syllabus-locked to A-Level board specifications (AS and A2) with structured notes, interactive diagrams, exam papers, case studies, and a real-time chat tutor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the EconNexus agentic ecosystem.
- [Microeconomics](/microeconomics): AS + A2 microeconomics chapters — scarcity, price system, elasticities, market failure, market structures, labor market, utility, production costs.
- [Macroeconomics](/macroeconomics): AS + A2 macroeconomics chapters — AD/AS, inflation, trade, exchange rates, balance of payments, national income, money and banking, development.
- [Notes](/notes): Full notes repository across all chapters.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Applied economics case studies with worked analysis.
- [Exam Intelligence](/exam-intelligence): Past-paper vault with reasoning and MCQ solutions.
- [Chat](/chat): Live AI tutor workspace with the 11 specialist personas.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Student reviews of EconNexus.
